author: bardic-inspiration
name: Cliffshadow Spider
summary: A slate-gray spider that strings its webs across cave mouths and waits in the dark just behind them.
description: Cliffshadow spiders favor the first few yards of a cave, where wind carries moths and bats into their webs. Miners clear the mouths of old shafts with torches before going in, and still find the silk grown back by spring.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.text: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.text: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs.

actions.name: Curtain Web

save.targets: one creature the spider can see within 30 feet

actions.onFailure: The target has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition until the web is destroyed. As an action, the restrained target or a creature within 5 feet of it can make a {dc=12} Strength (Athletics) check, freeing the target on a success. The web has AC 10, 5 {ref:glossary/hit-points}, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.
